description: This file defines the 'ChannelBookmark' model, including its data structure, validation, cloning, and related methods for handling channel bookmarks in Mattermost.

classes.name: ChannelBookmark
classes.description: Represents a bookmark within a channel, including its properties and validation logic.

classes.name: ChannelBookmarkPatch
classes.description: Structure for patch updates to a ChannelBookmark.

classes.name: ChannelBookmarkWithFileInfo
classes.description: Extends ChannelBookmark with associated file information.

classes.name: ChannelWithBookmarks
classes.description: Represents a channel with its associated bookmarks.

classes.name: ChannelWithTeamDataAndBookmarks
classes.description: Represents a channel with team data and bookmarks.

classes.name: UpdateChannelBookmarkResponse
classes.description: Response structure for updating or deleting a channel bookmark.

classes.name: ChannelBookmarkAndFileInfo
classes.description: Combines bookmark data with detailed file information.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of the bookmark's audit information.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the ChannelBookmark or ChannelBookmarkWithFileInfo.

methods.name: SetOriginal
methods.description: Creates a new bookmark based on the current one, resetting timestamps and IDs.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the bookmark for saving, generating IDs and sanitizing data.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Updates timestamps and sanitizes data before an update.

methods.name: ToBookmarkWithFileInfo
methods.description: Converts a ChannelBookmark to a ChannelBookmarkWithFileInfo, optionally including file info.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to a ChannelBookmark.

methods.name: ToChannelBookmarkWithFileInfo
methods.description: Converts a ChannelBookmarkAndFileInfo to a ChannelBookmarkWithFileInfo.
